as_is: A new preset needs every piece added here: the preset and its marker (config.rs), the Python test locator beside go_source/rust_source (python_source.rs, about 30 lines; it cannot reuse Go's brace-based func_text), the mutmut driver (needed because mutmut takes no diff and no names in cargo-mutants' shape), a `uv` stand-in that refuses what the real tool would refuse, and real reports. The wider edits generalise existing Rust-only branches (e2e.sh, standins' `mutates` in place of `name == "rust"`) rather than copying them. No existing function does any of this, and nothing it leaves behind becomes dead.
